summary: Iteration 41 verified end-to-end. Backend regression: 27/27 tests pass across test_smart_drop_paywall, test_compare_paywall, test_trade_analyzer, test_salary_cap_enforcement, test_standings_cap_consistency, test_retention_slots_admin. Frontend UX cog+modal flow fully working: (1) page-settings-cog renders in AppLayout header next to NotificationsPanel on /league/{id}/home and clicking it opens dashboard-settings-modal. (2) Modal shows all 3 sections (Stat Cards, Main Content, Sidebar Widgets) with 13 widget rows total — each with ChevronUp, ChevronDown, ArrowRight move-to-area dropdown, and a Switch. (3) Toggling League Standings Switch → data-state flips checked→unchecked, localStorage key `dynasty-ice-dashboard-config` updates, and the Standings heading disappears from the league home after Done. (4) ChevronDown on the first Main Content widget reorders — confirmed Main order changed from ['League Standings','Trading Block','League Schedule'] → ['Trading Block','League Standings','League Schedule']. (5) Turning off all 10 visible switches produces the `dashboard-empty-state` card with working `dashboard-empty-state-open-settings` link that re-opens the modal; Reset to Defaults restores. (6) page-settings-cog is NOT rendered on /standings or /team (count=0, confirming the opt-in prop pattern). Login via chriszarek@gmail.com / Chris2026! succeeded.
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.jsx correctly makes the cog opt-in via onSettingsClick prop — clean pattern, avoids coupling layout to dashboard config. Consider a future generic 'page actions' slot if more pages need header icons (keeps header composition declarative).

Index.tsx calls useDashboardConfig() and passes the full config object down to the modal — reasonable, but the returned object is recreated on every render (useState+useCallback). If this becomes a perf concern with more widgets, wrap returned object in useMemo.

DashboardSettingsModal area dropdown ('Move to X') does not verify the destination visibility state; a widget moved to another section keeps its visible flag. That's correct, but worth a quick UX callout in the description ('Moving keeps current show/hide state').

use-dashboard-config.ts: loadConfig merges stored+defaults by appending missing defaults at the end — new default widgets always land at the bottom of their area. This is the correct behavior but surfaces as 'new widgets appear at the end' for returning users — expected but worth documenting.

Empty-state card in Index.tsx only renders when visibleMain.length===0 && visibleSidebar.length===0 && visibleStats.length===0. If user hides only main+sidebar but keeps a stat card, the page legitimately shows just the stat row (no empty state) — verified working as designed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 41 complete. Cog+modal customization UX wired correctly at AppLayout (opt-in via onSettingsClick prop). Testids to use for future tests: page-settings-cog (header), dashboard-settings-modal (modal), dashboard-empty-state (all-hidden card), dashboard-empty-state-open-settings (link inside empty state). localStorage key: `dynasty-ice-dashboard-config`. Reset-to-defaults button works to restore widget config between tests. Confirmed cog does NOT leak onto other pages (/standings, /team) because those pages don't pass onSettingsClick. League Home path: /league/{LEAGUE_ID}/home with LEAGUE_ID=69e46af167999bfb85c39628. All 27 previous backend tests still green.
